params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} When '''Akali''' damages an enemy {{tip|champion}} with an {{tip|ability}}, she creates a ring around them for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent damaging abilities against champions. For 2 seconds, she gains {{as|{{pp|key=%|30 to 60 for 4|1 to 16}} {{sti|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} while moving away from the center of the ring. Only one ring may be active at a time.
params.description2: When '''Akali''' exits the ring, for 2 seconds, she regains the {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} while facing nearby enemy champions and becomes empowered with ''Swinging Kama'' for 4 seconds, during which she cannot create another ring.
params.description3: {{sbc|Swinging Kama:}} '''Akali's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} is empowered to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|range|{{tt|'''doubled''' range|Not necessarily increased by 125, check notes}}}} and deal {{pplevel|35 to 53 for 7; then + 9*x for 6; then + 15*x|formula=+3 per level until lvl 7; then +9 until lvl 13, then +15|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 60% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 55% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}.
params.custominfo: {{tt|-120|Ring offset from enemy's center, toward caster (at the time of being triggered)}}
params.notes:
* Enemies cannot see the ring, but can see the empower effect.
* ''Swinging Kama'' gives a static '''bonus''' range which doesn't change if '''Akali's''' range changes during it (i.e {{ii|Rapid Firecannon}}):
** If ''Rapid Firecannon'' fully charges within ''Swinging Kama's'' duration, '''Akali's''' total range increases to {{tt|337.5|(125 + 125 (which is the bonus range Swinging Kama gives)){{times}}1.35}}.
** If ''Rapid Firecannon'' fully charges before gaining ''Swinging Kama'', '''Akali's''' total range is increased to {{tt|395|125{{times}}1.35 + 125{{times}}1.35 (which is the bonus range Swinging Kama gives){{times}}1.35 (further increased by Rapid Firecannon)}}.
* The ring will be created around the last target hit by ''{{ai|Five Point Strike|Akali}}''.
* The empowered attack will trigger but not be consumed nor apply its effects against {{tip|structures}} and {{tip|wards}}.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{cis|Akali}} damaging {{tip|abilities}} against a champion create a ring around them for a few seconds, and she gains {{sti|{{as|move speed}}}} while moving away from the ring.
params.blurb2: Once '''Akali''' exits the ring, she regains the {{sti|{{as|move speed}}}} towards enemy champions and empowers her next {{tip|basic attack}} with {{sti|range|'''bonus''' range}} and {{as|magic damage}}.

description.plain: Innate: When Akali damages an enemy champion with an ability, she creates a ring around them for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent damaging abilities against champions. For 2 seconds, she gains 30% – 60% (based on level) bonus movement speed while moving away from the center of the ring. Only one ring may be active at a time.

description2.plain: When Akali exits the ring, for 2 seconds, she regains the bonus movement speed while facing nearby enemy champions and becomes empowered with Swinging Kama for 4 seconds, during which she cannot create another ring.

description3.plain: Swinging Kama: Akali's next basic attack is empowered to have an uncancellable windup, gain doubled range and deal ⟦pplevel⟧ (+ 60% bonus AD) (+ 55% AP) bonus magic damage.

blurb.plain: Innate: Akali damaging abilities against a champion create a ring around them for a few seconds, and she gains move speed while moving away from the ring.

blurb2.plain: Once Akali exits the ring, she regains the move speed towards enemy champions and empowers her next basic attack with bonus range and magic damage.

custominfo.note: Ring offset from enemy's center, toward caster (at the time of being triggered)

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Akali''' restores {{sti|{{as|100 energy}}}} over {{fd|0.4}} seconds and gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} that decays over 2 seconds. She also detonates a smoke bomb a fixed distance away in the target direction, creating a circular shroud that expands over the next 5 seconds into a ring. The shroud does not permeate terrain, and will expand toward nearby enemy champions. While the shroud is active, '''Akali's''' {{as|'''maximum''' energy}} is increased by {{as|100|energy}}.
params.leveling:
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|30 to 50}}%}}
{{st|Shroud Duration|{{ap|5 to 7}} seconds}}
params.description2: Entering the shroud renders '''Akali''' {{tip|invisibility|invisible}}, unless she is {{tip|dash|dashing}}.
params.description3: Declaring a basic attack or casting an ability will break the invisibility and prevent '''Akali''' from entering it again for {{pp|changedisplay=true|round=3|1;0.9;0.825;0.725;0.625|1;7;10;13;16}} seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks and casts.
params.description4: ''The {{ai|Shuriken Flip|Akali|marked}} section of Twilight Shroud will linger for the mark's duration, even after the shroud ends.''
params.description5: '''''Akali''' can move during Twilight Shroud's cast time.''
params.notes:
* '''Akali''' will also not gain the {{tip|invisibility}} if she is {{si|Recall|Recalling}}.
* It is possible for '''Akali''' to detonate the smoke bomb on the far side of terrain from her current location.
* ''Twilight Shroud's'' effects begin at the start of the cast time.
* Using a basic attack breaks the stealth at the start of the attack windup.
<!-- Blurb -->
params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Akali}} restores {{as|{{sti|energy}}}} and gains a brief burst of {{sti|ms|{{as|move speed}}}}. She also drops a smoke shroud that makes her {{tip|invisibility|invisible}}, attacking or using abilities will briefly reveal her.
params.blurb2: The shroud will expand into a ring over a few seconds, during which '''Akali''' gains increased {{as|energy}}.

description.plain: Active: Akali restores 100 energy over 0.4 seconds and gains bonus movement speed that decays over 2 seconds. She also detonates a smoke bomb a fixed distance away in the target direction, creating a circular shroud that expands over the next 5 seconds into a ring. The shroud does not permeate terrain, and will expand toward nearby enemy champions. While the shroud is active, Akali's maximum energy is increased by 100.

description2.plain: Entering the shroud renders Akali invisible, unless she is dashing.

description3.plain: Declaring a basic attack or casting an ability will break the invisibility and prevent Akali from entering it again for 1 – 0.625 (based on level) seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks and casts.

description4.plain: The Shuriken Flip section of Twilight Shroud will linger for the mark's duration, even after the shroud ends.

description5.plain: Akali can move during Twilight Shroud's cast time.

blurb.plain: Active: Akali restores energy and gains a brief burst of move speed. She also drops a smoke shroud that makes her invisible, attacking or using abilities will briefly reveal her.

blurb2.plain: The shroud will expand into a ring over a few seconds, during which Akali gains increased energy.

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Akali''' {{tip|dash|flips}} backward after {{fd|0.15}} seconds into the cast time, and after the cast time throws a shuriken in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit.
params.description2: The shuriken ''marks'' and {{tip|true sight|reveals}} the enemy or the last ''{{ai|Twilight Shroud|Akali}}'' smoke section hit for 3 seconds, during which ''Shuriken Flip'' can be recast to consume the mark.
params.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Akali''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} towards the marked target or smoke section. Against enemies she deals {{as|magic damage}} upon arrival.
params.description4: '''''Akali''' will not flip backwards if she is {{tip|immobilized}} or {{tip|grounded}} in the first {{fd|0.15}} seconds of the cast time. {{ai|Twilight Shroud|Akali}} and {{ai|Perfect Execution|Akali}} can be cast during the recast's dash.''
params.target range: {{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|825|Shuriken range, based off of Akali's original location}}
params.speed: {{dv|{{tt|1800|Shuriken missile speed}}|{{tt|1500|First and second dash speed}}}}
params.notes:
* '''Akali''' will track the target if they change locations.
** She will not stop tracking the target until she reaches them, as there is no maximum tracking distance.
* Both casts count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
* ''Shuriken Flip's'' first cast does not interrupt '''Akali's''' previous move or attack orders.
** The recast does.
* ''Shuriken Flip'' cannot be recast if the target is {{tip|untargetable}} or is in another realm.
* '''Akali''' will be ordered to basic attack the target after the recast's dash ends.
* '''Akali''' will dash backwards up-to 400 units in a straight line. This dash can cross terrain if the end point is beyond it. If she would end the dash inside terrain, she will instead look for a location in either direction left or right that is outside of terrain and dash there. If there is no such location, she will dash only up to the wall at her normal speed, ending the dash early.
{{Effect at cast time end}}
** The shuriken missile will fire from wherever '''Akali''' is at the end of the cast time (usually mid-dash), but always towards and reaching the location that was 825 units in front of her at the start of cast. The only exception is if she moves via {{si|Flash}}, in which case the range of the missile is decreased relative to the distance she blinked.
* Killing an enemy with the shuriken will still mark the last area of the {{ai|Twilight Shroud|Akali|shroud}} hit.
* Attempting to cast {{ai|Five Point Strike|Akali}} during either dash will buffer it to cast as soon as the dash ends.
{{ct|attack=false|move=false|cast={{ai|Twilight Shroud|Akali}} is usable. {{ai|Shuriken Flip|Akali}} is disabled for 10 seconds and then interrupts. Both dashes of {{ai|Perfect Execution|Akali}} interrupt.|items=true,,,interrupts|spells=true,interrupts,true,true,false}}

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Akali''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} 750 units in the direction of the target enemy {{tip|champion}}, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies she passes through. If this hits an enemy, she flips over them to continue the dash up to the normal range but for at least another 150 units.
params.description2: ''Perfect Execution'' can be recast after a {{fd|2.5}}-second {{tt|static cooldown|Unaffected by ability haste}} within 10 seconds of the first activation.
params.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Akali''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} {{tt|800|Estimated}} units in the target direction, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies she passes through, increased by {{as|{{pp|key=%|key1=%|type=target's '''missing''' health|0 to 200 for 11|0 to 70|formula=2.86% per 1% of target's '''missing''' health, capped at 70% '''missing''' health}}|health}}.
params.leveling3: {{st|Minimum Magic Damage|{{ap|70 to 210}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}}|Maximum Magic Damage|{{ap|70*3 to 210*3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30*3}}% AP)}}}}
params.outofrange: Walk in range of the target unit to cast (first cast)
params.notes:
* Both casts count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
* With the first cast, '''Akali''' can dash up to a maximum of 900 units if the first enemy she hit was at the maximum dash range.
* Casting {{si|Flash}} during either dashes will interrupt them, but '''Akali''' will deal damage to any enemies she comes in contact with at the new location.
** Enemies already hit by either of ''Perfect Execution's'' casts cannot be affected more than once by the same cast.
* {{ai|Shuriken Flip|Akali}} can be used during the initial dash if it is cast after ''Perfect Execution's'' cast time finishes.
